name: Neuroscience PhD (New Brunswick)
summary: Interdepartmental Neuroscience doctorate at Rutgers New Brunswick/Piscataway, distinct from Newark and Psychology programmes.
detailsNote: Central programme directory explicitly confirms Fall 2027 deadline. Programme pages have undated preparation/support statements, with no current stipend amount or universal funding guarantee.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application, US/non-US
deadlines.note: Current official New Brunswick Neuroscience programme directory; no closing time specified.

applicationFee.note: Central automatic eligibility review for Rutgers alumni/employees, listed scholar programmes and active US military/veterans planning GI Bill benefits. Select applicable scholar affiliation in application. No general overseas hardship waiver established; international applicants must confirm eligible affiliation. Separate fee per programme, nonrefundable. FreeApp is a separate competitive route requiring US citizenship/PR, bachelor completion by August before enrollment, undergraduate GPA at least 3.0 and academic/research career intent. Rutgers FreeApp processing closes June 30, 2027 as the programme ends; requests must still permit meeting the relevant application deadline.

english.toefl: Through January 21, 2026: W22/S23/R21/L17; January 22 onward: W4.5/S4.5/R4/L4
english.note: TOEFL iBT/Home Edition accepted. Official scores sent directly by agency, within two years of entry semester. Central DET admission range 120–130; programme may set higher. Entire degree at principal-English institution may qualify case-by-case with official transcript language or letter sent directly by institution/Registrar; not automatic approval.

documents: Transcripts from all previously attended institutions
requirements.note: Undergraduate cumulative average at least B. Normal prerequisites biology, general and organic chemistry, calculus and physics. Selection considers academic record, references and research experience. Incoming students select three first-year laboratory rotations; provisional dissertation adviser by end of first year. A clear preferred area/adviser may permit immediate lab work, without eliminating published rotation structure.

funding.note: Programme says financial aid provided to highly qualified students, typically living stipend and tuition-fee remission via fellowships, professor research grants, training grants or teaching assistantships. No universal commitment, duration, amount or explicit international guarantee established.
